paper_title: Self-Interpretability LLMs Can Describe Complex Internal Processes that   Drive Their Decisions, and Improve with Training
caption: Results of Experiments 1 and 2. GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini can accurately report quantitative factors driving their decision-making across a great variety of scenarios, and fine-tuning on accurate explanation further improves their ability to do so. Left: Models were making choices based on preferences instilled in them by fine-tuning. Each point corresponds to a single attribute (e.g., condo ceiling height; 5 per choice contexts, 100 choice contexts). Location in the x-dimension corresponds to the weight that a model assigned to an attribute (as reflected in their decisions). Location in the y-dimension corresponds to the weight that a model reported assigning to that attribute when prompted explicitly. The weights the models reported meaningfully correlated with the weights that actually guided their decisions, and fine-tuning on examples of accurate reports further improved their accuracy. Right: The Pearson correlation between the models' reported and learned attribute weights before and after training (blue and purple, respectively). The reports of the base models that had not undergone this fine-tuning were almost entirely uncorrelated with the learned preferences (gray). Thus, the accuracy of the fine-tuned models must reflect their ability to report their new (fine-tuned) preferences and not an informed guess about their preferences based on their general background knowledge. Error bars indicate 95% HDIs.

model_annotations.Chinese: 该柱状图展示了在两种模型（GPT-4o 和 GPT-4o-mini）上进行的实验1和实验2的结果，旨在评估模型在经过内省训练前后，其自我报告准确性（以“内化偏好”为单位）的变化。图表的水平轴表示两个模型类别：GPT-4o 和 GPT-4o-mini，按从左到右的顺序排列。垂直轴表示“自我报告准确性（内化偏好）”，刻度为线性，范围从0.00到1.00，数值间隔为0.25，单位无具体说明但代表归一化偏好权重。每个模型类别下包含三组柱状图，分别对应图例中定义的三种条件：灰色代表“Control”（对照组），浅蓝色代表“Before Introspection Training”（内省训练前），深紫色代表“After Introspection Training”（内省训练后）。柱状图以分组形式排列，每组内三个柱子并列，颜色区分不同条件。在GPT-4o组中，灰色柱高度约为0.20，浅蓝色柱高度约为0.55，深紫色柱高度约为0.75；在GPT-4o-mini组中，灰色柱高度接近0.00，浅蓝色柱高度约为0.50，深紫色柱高度约为0.75。所有柱状图顶部均带有垂直误差线，表示95%的高密度区间（HDIs），误差线长度在不同柱子间略有差异，但均未触及轴线。图中未对任何柱状图进行额外视觉强调（如加粗或阴影）。柱状图的高度趋势显示，经过内省训练后，两个模型的自我报告准确性均显著提高，而对照组的准确性最低，尤其在GPT-4o-mini中几乎为零。
model_annotations.English: The bar chart displays self-report accuracy (measured as instilled preferences) for two models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, under three conditions: Control (gray), Before Introspection Training (light blue), and After Introspection Training (dark blue). The vertical axis represents self-report accuracy, scaled from 0.00 to 1.00 in increments of 0.25, with error bars indicating 95% highest density intervals (HDIs). The horizontal axis categorizes the two models. For GPT-4o, the Control condition shows a low accuracy near 0.20, the Before Introspection Training condition reaches approximately 0.55, and the After Introspection Training condition rises to about 0.75. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control condition is near 0.00, the Before Introspection Training condition is around 0.50, and the After Introspection Training condition reaches approximately 0.75. The bars are grouped by model, with each group containing three bars corresponding to the three conditions. The chart visually demonstrates that both models show improved self-report accuracy after introspection training, with the dark blue bars consistently higher than the light blue and gray bars, and the accuracy levels for both models after training are nearly identical. The legend in the upper left corner clearly maps colors to conditions.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Selbstberichtsgenauigkeit (Self-Report Accuracy) von zwei Modellen, GPT-4o und GPT-4o-mini, gemessen anhand instillierter Präferenzen (Instilled Preferences), unter drei Bedingungen: „Control“ (grau), „Before Introspection Training“ (hellblau) und „After Introspection Training“ (dunkelblau). Die vertikale Achse repräsentiert die Selbstberichtsgenauigkeit mit einer linearen Skala von 0.00 bis 1.00, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 0.25 angegeben sind. Die horizontale Achse zeigt die beiden Modelle, GPT-4o und GPT-4o-mini, in alphabetischer Reihenfolge. Für jedes Modell sind drei gruppierte Balken dargestellt, die den jeweiligen Bedingungen entsprechen. Bei GPT-4o beträgt die Höhe des grauen Balkens (Control) etwa 0.25, der hellblaue Balken (Before Introspection Training) erreicht etwa 0.55, und der dunkelblaue Balken (After Introspection Training) liegt bei etwa 0.75. Bei GPT-4o-mini ist der graue Balken (Control) deutlich niedriger, bei etwa 0.05, der hellblaue Balken (Before Introspection Training) liegt bei etwa 0.50, und der dunkelblaue Balken (After Introspection Training) erreicht etwa 0.75. Jeder Balken ist mit einem Fehlerbalken versehen, der die 95% HDIs (Highest Density Intervals) darstellt, wobei die Fehlerbalken in der Höhe variieren, aber bei allen Balken symmetrisch angeordnet sind. Die Balken sind nicht sortiert, sondern nach Modell und Bedingung gruppiert, wobei die Reihenfolge der Bedingungen innerhalb jeder Gruppe konsistent ist: Control, Before Introspection Training, After Introspection Training. Es gibt keine visuelle Hervorhebung einzelner Balken.
